'''''Marath'damane''''' is a [[Seanchan]] term for any woman who is able to channel the [[One Power]] but has not yet been leashed by an ''[[a'dam]]''. Literally, it means "those who must be leashed" in the [[Old Tongue]]. All women who can channel and who are not leashed are considered ''marath'damane'' by the Seanchan, including [[Aes Sedai]], [[Wise One]]s, [[Windfinder|Windfinders]], and the [[Kin]].

Once a ''marath'damane'' is leashed by an ''a'dam'', she is called a ''[[damane]]''.

On the Seanchan continent, there are no ''marath'damane'', as all girls are tested young and leashed before they begin to channel.
